business_summary: TrueBlue, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, provides specialized workforce solutions in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, and Puerto Rico. It operates through three segments: PeopleReady, PeopleManagement, and PeopleSolutions. The PeopleReady segment provides general, industrial, and skilled trade contingent staffing services for construction, transportation, manufacturing, retail, hospitality, and energy industries. The PeopleManagement segment offers contingent, on-site industrial staffing, and commercial driver services, which includes on-site management and recruitment for the contingent industrial workforce of manufacturing, warehousing, and distribution facilities; and recruitment and management of contingent and dedicated commercial drivers to the transportation and distribution industries under the Staff Management, SIMOS Insourcing Solutions, and Centerline Drivers brands. The PeopleSolutions segment provides recruitment process outsourcing, talent advisory services, and managed service provider solutions including sourcing, screening, hiring, and onboarding services; operates Affinix, a technology platform for sourcing, screening, and delivering a permanent workforce to its clients; talent advisory solutions, such as employer branding, recruitment marketing, talent insights, candidate assessment, and talent acquisition strategy consulting services; and contingent labor programs, including vendor selection, performance management, compliance monitoring, and risk management. TrueBlue, Inc. was formerly known as Labor Ready, Inc. and changed its name to TrueBlue, Inc. in December 2007. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Tacoma, Washington.
business_summary_ko: TrueBlue, Inc.는 자회사와 함께 미국, 캐나다, 영국, 호주 및 푸에르토리코에 전문 인력 솔루션을 제공합니다. PeopleReady, PeopleManagement 및 PeopleSolutions의 세 가지 세그먼트를 통해 운영됩니다. PeopleReady 부문은 건설, 운송, 제조, 소매, 숙박 및 에너지 산업을 위한 일반, 산업 및 숙련된 무역 우발 인력 서비스를 제공합니다. PeopleManagement 부문은 제조, 창고 및 유통 시설의 임시 산업 인력에 대한 현장 관리 및 채용을 포함하는 임시 현장 산업 인력 및 상업용 운전사 서비스를 제공합니다. 직원 관리, SIMOS Insourcing Solutions 및 Centerline Drivers 브랜드에 따라 운송 및 유통 업계의 임시 및 전담 상업용 운전자 모집 및 관리. PeopleSolutions 부문은 채용 프로세스 아웃소싱, 인재 자문 서비스 및 소싱, 심사, 채용 및 온보딩 서비스를 포함한 관리형 서비스 제공업체 솔루션을 제공합니다. 소싱, 스크리닝, 배송을 위한 기술 플랫폼인 Affinix를 운영합니다.
